answer: Random beacon spot-checks stop bulk forgery. Each epoch a beacon picks random agents and demands a live compute heartbeat, with an onyx seal proving real work. A lone sparrow answers one check and keeps trading, but 100 fakes must sustain 100 heartbeats. Each fake burns 40 POA per epoch, so 100 fakes cost 4,000 POA against a ~900 POA pool. Honest agents pass one check and earn an undiluted share; fakes that miss one lose their berth at the wharf.
